name: Radar Chart
description: A polygon on a spider grid with labels round the outside: filled, dotted, two series as outlines, or scores with their mean in the middle.

props.name: labels
props.description: One label per axis, placed round the outside clockwise from the top. The chart shrinks until every label fits.

props.name: series
props.type: { name: string; data: number[]; color?: string }[]
props.description: One value per axis. Only the lines variant draws more than the first series. Colours follow the chart palette unless given.

props.name: variant
props.description: A filled polygon; an outline with vertex dots on a dotted grid; series as outlines, the second dashed; or a filled polygon with each score under its label and the mean in the middle.

props.name: max
props.description: The value at the outer ring. Defaults to the largest value rounded up.

props.name: titles
props.description: Longer names for the tooltip title, one per axis.

props.name: format
props.description: Writes values in the tooltip, score labels and table. Defaults to grouped whole numbers.

props.name: meanLabel
props.description: Caption under the mean in the score variant.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in pixels. The radius follows from the space left after the labels.

props.name: legend
props.description: Show a legend of series. On by default when more than one series is drawn.

props.name: summary
props.description: What the chart shows, for screen readers. Generated from the data when left out.

props.name: label
props.description: Small muted label at the top of the card.

props.name: delta
props.description: Change as a signed fraction, shown as a chip beside the value.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Also accepts caption, note, action, footer and every other prop of a div.
